features.observed_source: Contest and individual Profile participation, problem assignment, live/spectate/virtual modes exist.
features.required_changes: Configure a minimal individual contest and native pages; preserve author/tester unranked participation.
features.verification_required: B10: two real accounts join/submit; test author/tester unranked status and no cross-contest access.

features.observed_source: Organizations/classes, membership/admins and private/join-only contest restrictions exist; these are not teams.
features.required_changes: Map course groups to native organizations/classes; configure visibility versus admission separately.
features.verification_required: C04/D04: outsider/direct-URL denial, member admission, removal and organization-admin scope checks.

features.observed_source: Authors/curators/testers and edit-own/edit-all permissions exist; no SecureExam author-mode contract is established.
features.required_changes: Reuse scoped checks; add only missing grant/dashboard/audit behavior. UI mode must not grant permissions.
features.verification_required: A06/C03/C04: author A cannot edit B; forged requests cannot self-promote; reviewers and test submissions stay scoped.

features.feature: Participant rosters and private student details
features.observed_source: Native membership/participation listings exist; the latter lists one user’s participations, not the requested author email/student roster.
features.required_changes: Add scoped contest roster with required collected fields, private emails/student ID, filters/pagination and authorized exports; do not expose public member data as a private roster.
features.verification_required: C01/D09/D10: assigned author sees only own roster; participant/cross-group export denied; verify private fields and CSV escaping.

features.observed_source: GoogleOAuth2 and social-auth account association exist. The local verify_email function only checks nonempty email; provider verification semantics were not audited.
features.required_changes: Configure provider/redirects and audit the pinned backend’s verified-email claim and linking policy; retain local login for offline operation.
features.verification_required: C02: callback/login/logout, CSRF/state and account linking; reject missing/untrusted email claims; local login works independently of Google.

features.observed_source: Registration/email-change forms query for duplicates; site uses Django User. Django 4.2 default email field is not unique. OAuth verification/association and concurrency guarantees remain unproven.
features.required_changes: Choose normalization/verification policy and race-safe uniqueness across signup, OAuth/linking, email changes, admin/provisioning; do not rely on a form query alone.
features.verification_required: C01/C02: concurrent duplicate signup/link/change, case/collation policy, unverified versus verified provider identities, activation replay and recovery.

features.observed_source: The stock participant join route rejects pre-start live entry; invited/private_contestants are access controls, not proof of a separate preregistration lifecycle.
features.required_changes: Add/map explicit registration-open/closed and pre-start entry state with server-side eligibility/capacity rules.
features.verification_required: D07/D08: scheduled/open/closed boundaries; concurrent admission versus start/capacity; preserve registration time and submissions.

features.feature: Late entry and common contest clock
features.observed_source: Live joining after start and common clock when time_limit is None exist; a per-participant duration is also supported. No requested late-registration switch was located in these paths.
features.required_changes: Explicitly select common-clock mode; add late-entry policy controls and consistent deadline enforcement, without granting late entrants extra time.
features.verification_required: A10/D08/B11: before/at/after start/end, late toggle and shared end; check solve penalty uses official start/server receipt, not grading completion.

features.observed_source: Leave clears Profile.current_contest; it does not delete participation or implement pre-start deregistration. Do not label that endpoint deregistration.
features.required_changes: Implement distinct pre-start withdrawal and post-start prohibition; retain attempt/history and explicit author removal/disqualification semantics.
features.verification_required: D07/D08/D11: withdraw before start, deny once running even without submissions, rejoin semantics and no lost historical record.

features.feature: Problem installation into website and worker
features.observed_source: Native problem/data storage, batches/dependencies and manual management exist; bridge reads database time/memory. Stock checker choices omit bridged. Both stock language fixtures omit CPP23 even though the existing worker supports it.
features.required_changes: Map converted code/statement/limits/languages and private files atomically; preserve CPP23 bridged/testlib init rather than blindly regenerate through builtin-only checker UI. Verify import versus manually-managed route. Provision matching CPP23 database/allowed-language metadata.
features.verification_required: B04–B06: bytes/case order, active samples, group dependencies, checker standard, DB/dispatch limits and safe statement assets; real browser AC/WA after installation. Confirm CPP23 appears in the live site/worker language matrix.

features.observed_source: Native upload edits DMOJ problem data; no Polygon reader/job/publication workflow was found in the inspected site paths. Our existing compat/convert.py already handles the supported CLI conversion subset.
features.required_changes: Wrap the existing converter with private bounded uploads, job findings, safe preview, versioned atomic publication and worker installation. Do not rewrite or widen the converter silently.
features.verification_required: C05–C14: malicious/unsupported ZIP rejection, bytes/checker/limit/group preservation, partial import rollback, independent multi-ZIP status and isolated prepublication probe.

features.observed_source: Native forms store source/participation, apply language/rate checks and dispatch via bridge; handler supplies database seconds/memory and optional language overrides.
features.required_changes: Reuse native persistence/transport. Add only missing receipt/idempotency/version/rejudge safeguards after contract review; do not replace dispatch with our CLI regression runner.
features.verification_required: B07–B09/E09: browser AC/WA/CE/RTE/TLE and unavailable-worker behavior; receipt identity, loss/retry, ordering and correct DB-to-worker limits.

features.observed_source: Per-case status/time/memory/points/batches/output/feedback are stored and rendered. SC is displayed separately. Native feedback rendering is not our full contest privacy policy.
features.required_changes: Map original case/group identity and enforce configured feedback/source/hidden-data rules across pages, queries, events and exports; filter sensitive checker diagnostics.
features.verification_required: B09/E11/E12: compare UI to actual case records, distinguish SC/IE from AC, inspect network/event payloads and test cross-user access with hidden-data fixtures.

features.observed_source: ICPC/IOI formats and rankings exist. ICPC has last-score-altering-time tiebreak and excludes only IE/CE from failed-attempt counting; IOI16 combines best batches across submissions, while legacy ioi chooses a best submission.
features.required_changes: A10 must map/configure or adapt the exact requested solved/penalty/tie and best-submission rules. Native format names alone are insufficient; preserve judge results versus contest points distinction.
features.verification_required: B11/F08/F09: hand-calculated solve/failure/tie/late-entry sequences; equal solved/penalty shares rank; group behavior, rejudge, provisional/frozen standings and skipped-case scoring.

features.observed_source: The inspected submit flow uses Ace; Monaco appearing as a font name elsewhere is not an editor integration.
features.required_changes: Add a bounded Monaco component while retaining native submission/auth/language behavior, local assets, accessibility and a text fallback; no full-site SPA required.
features.verification_required: E03/E04/E14/E15: enabled language choices, source round trip, keyboard/zoom/resizing and usable fallback when editor assets fail.

features.observed_source: Ctrl-S manually writes localStorage under submit:<language>; key has no account/problem/contest scope and this is not automatic saving or server synchronization.
features.required_changes: Add timed/debounced per-account/problem/contest/language drafts and truthful local/synced state; specify tab conflicts and optional server sync before implementing it.
features.verification_required: E05/E06: reload recovery, language/problem/account isolation on shared browser, concurrent tabs, offline edits and reconnect conflict behavior.

features.observed_source: No custom-stdin Run route was identified in inspected submit/URL/dispatch paths; existing testcase query displays judged cases. A native compatible worker extension was not established.
features.required_changes: A12 must locate supported execution/protocol extension points or scope custom work, then implement an isolated bounded custom-input path with separate quotas, no hidden data and no scoring.
features.verification_required: A12/E07/E08: actual stdout/stderr/compile/runtime/timeout behavior, input/output caps, authorization, no standings writes and no starvation of official submissions.

features.observed_source: Inspected participation/submission identity points to one Profile. No team roster/captain/entry model was located in these paths; organization membership is not team scoring.
features.required_changes: Extend native contest identity for invitations/acceptance, unique membership, roster locks, actual submitter plus team entry and shared aggregation. Do not use shared credentials.
features.verification_required: F01–F07: concurrent membership/invite acceptance, start-time lock, attribution, one credit for simultaneous AC and prior-failure counting across teammates.

features.observed_source: Private individual contests are a useful base; scoring format does not enforce exactly two complete sides or configurable team sizes.
features.required_changes: After team identity exists, add match admission/readiness rules, capacity enforcement and incomplete-match handling; do not treat ICPC selection as competition-format selection.
features.verification_required: F03/F04: exactly two entries, required members per side, one entry per person and concurrent last-slot admission; incomplete sides cannot silently start.

features.observed_source: Native authenticated worker set, queue, problem/language matching and tier/disabled handling exist. No SecureExam multi-machine deployment or immutable-version pool routing was tested.
features.required_changes: Reuse bridge scheduling; add tested enrollment/revocation, private version synchronization, approved-pool/timing policy and recovery operations where absent.
features.verification_required: B03/A11/G03–G11: two trusted workers, wrong problem/runtime/version refusal, disconnect/reconnect/duplicate-result safety and measured throughput; no 300-job claim from source.

limitations: Source availability means inspected code exists, not that SecureExam has deployed it.
Negative findings are bounded to selected model/view/template/dispatch paths; no exhaustive ecosystem/plugin audit.
Asset submodule and third-party authentication backend code were not fetched/installed; verified-provider claim handling remains to audit.
Candidate Django 4.2 is unsupported; A09 gate remains before site feature work.
